$comment: Desired state of the production Fly app's launch flags and the secrets copied from GitHub, applied ONLY by .github/workflows/fly-env-sync.yml (plan -> apply -> verify). Runbook: docs/runbooks/launch-flags.md.

flags: each value is "unset" (the name must not exist on Fly; the code default applies) or one value from that name's closed set (ENV_RULES `values` in src/common/env-validation.ts). Flag values are not secret.

secrets: "github-secret" (Fly must hold the GitHub Actions secret of the same name, which must be set and non-empty), "present" (must exist on Fly; its value is owned by another workflow and never written here) or "unset" (must not exist on Fly).
One entry per line, so every flip is a one-line diff. Every flip is its own audited PR; merging a PR changes nothing until the operator dispatches the workflow in apply mode.
gates: why each name has its current value and what must be true before it flips. excluded: registered names this manifest deliberately does not manage, with the reason.
test/ci/fly-env-manifest.spec.ts validates this file against ENV_RULES, the preconditions in scripts/fly-env/fly-env-manifest.js and the workflow's env block.

gates.FEATURE_AI_CONSENT_LEDGER_ENABLED: Wave B. Flip to true in the same window as the backend #626 deploy (operator ruling OR-110-4): #626 without the ledger blocks every client-data AI call. Unset = off (the code turns on only for 'true').
gates.FEATURE_COMMUNITY_SCHEMA: Wave A community core. Unset = on (only 'false' disables); set 'true' to make it explicit. 'false' turns the community API off even when FEATURE_COMMUNITY_API is true.
gates.FEATURE_COMMUNITY_API: Wave A community core: master switch (CommunityFeatureFlagGuard on every community controller; off = 503). Flip after the community report/block lane (#610) is deployed, before App Review uses community.
gates.FEATURE_COMMUNITY_POSTS: Wave A community core: Lab-post writes (CommunityPostsEnabledGuard). Needs FEATURE_COMMUNITY_API=true. Same gate as FEATURE_COMMUNITY_API.
gates.FEATURE_COMMUNITY_MESSAGES: Wave A community core: cohort messages and post comments (CommunityMessagesEnabledGuard). Needs FEATURE_COMMUNITY_API=true. Same gate as FEATURE_COMMUNITY_API.
gates.FEATURE_COMMUNITY_PUSH: Wave A community core: community push notifications (service-level). Needs FEATURE_COMMUNITY_API=true. Same gate as FEATURE_COMMUNITY_API.
gates.FEATURE_COMMUNITY_REALTIME: Wave A community core: live fan-out to open Hall and Cohort screens (service-level). Needs FEATURE_COMMUNITY_API=true. Same gate as FEATURE_COMMUNITY_API.
gates.FEATURE_COMMUNITY_VOICE_NOTES: Owner 10-01 20:32: ON at launch once voice notes are reportable (report target, report action, moderation queue, block parity), audited and device-passed. Needs FEATURE_COMMUNITY_API=true.
gates.FEATURE_COMMUNITY_VOICE_NOTES_REQUIRE_EN: Voice-note entitlement gate. No launch decision; stays unset (off) until the owner asks for paid-only voice notes. Needs FEATURE_COMMUNITY_VOICE_NOTES=true.
gates.FEATURE_COMMUNITY_DM: Direct messages: not in the clinic mobile profile (EXPO_PUBLIC_FF_COMMUNITY_DM off). Stays unset (off) until S-REACH decides. Needs FEATURE_COMMUNITY_API=true.
gates.FEATURE_COMMUNITY_ACKS: Coach ack signals in the coach inbox: not in the ledger core set. Stays unset (off) until S-REACH decides. Needs FEATURE_COMMUNITY_API=true.
gates.FEATURE_COMMUNITY_PLAN_TAGS: Plan-tag context on messages: not in the ledger core set. Stays unset (off) until S-REACH decides. Needs FEATURE_COMMUNITY_API=true.
gates.FEATURE_COMMUNITY_SEARCH: Community search: not in the ledger core set. Stays unset (off) until S-REACH decides. Needs FEATURE_COMMUNITY_API=true.
gates.FEATURE_COMMUNITY_TELEMETRY: Community telemetry events: not in the ledger core set. Stays unset (off) until S-REACH decides. Needs FEATURE_COMMUNITY_API=true.
gates.FEATURE_COMMUNITY_WEARABLE_PROMPTS: Wearable prompts in community: wearables lane decision. Stays unset (off). Needs FEATURE_COMMUNITY_API=true.
gates.FEATURE_COMMUNITY_AI_TRIAGE: Ledger: stay off (community AI triage, not in clinic scope; AI paths wait for R2b acceptance). Needs FEATURE_COMMUNITY_API=true.
gates.FEATURE_COMMUNITY_CHALLENGES: Ledger: stay off until S-REACH decides. Needs FEATURE_COMMUNITY_API=true.
gates.FEATURE_COMMUNITY_EVENTS: Ledger: stay off until S-REACH decides. Needs FEATURE_COMMUNITY_API=true.
gates.FEATURE_COMMUNITY_CLASSROOM_POSTS: Ledger: stay off until S-REACH decides. Needs FEATURE_COMMUNITY_API=true.
gates.FEATURE_MESSAGING_CORE_V2: A3-MSG-CORE (annex): unified inbox, edit/delete, swipe-reply, pins, mute and read-up-to on the 1:1 coach thread. Stays unset (off) until dual audit approves the backend PR and the mobile thread polish passes a device pass. Not a community flag (no FEATURE_COMMUNITY_API dependency). Roll back with 'unset'.
gates.BOOKING_REMINDERS_ENABLED: Wave A, operator ruling OR-110-5: flip to the literal 'on' in the same deploy window as #632 (after #632/#634 the code accepts only 'on'; unset = off there). 'true' would silently turn reminders off.
gates.SIGNUP_ROLE_CHOICE_ENABLED: Owner D4 (10-01 12:55): ON at launch and stays a working kill switch. Unset = on (only 'false', '0' or 'off' turn it off); set 'true' to make it explicit, 'false' to make every signup a client.
gates.FEATURE_COACHLESS_HOME: A1-COACHLESS (annex): coachless Home banner, coach-code sheet and scripted Roman card. Stay unset (off) until both audit lenses approve the backend and mobile PRs, the owner has saved the featured-coach offer through PUT /admin/featured-coach, and a device pass is done; then flip to true. Kill: unset (off).
gates.COACH_WELCOME_SCHEDULER_ENABLED: Clinic C05 item 6 (#609): ships on and stays a working kill switch. Unset = on (only 'false', '0' or 'off' turn it off). It sends nothing until the owner enables a coach's welcome setting at C04. Emergency kill: set 'false' (scheduling and sending stop, the erasure sweep keeps running); never unset to kill.
gates.WORKOUT_REMINDERS_ENABLED: Clinic C05 item 7 (#609): ships on; reminders are launch scope from the client's first-session day and clients opt out in Settings > Notifications. Unset = on (only 'false', '0' or 'off' turn it off). Emergency kill: set 'false' (every reminder stops, the erasure sweep keeps running); never unset to kill.
gates.FEATURE_WEARABLES_INGEST_POST: Wave B, true: backend ingest (#623) deployed; mobile H1-H8 merged; apply only after mobile #378 (C-370-2 burst, C-370-3 sleep) is approved and merged, then the owner device pass on Apple Health and Health Connect. Unset = off (only 'true'); emergency kill: unset (the ingest routes return 503 wearables_ingest_disabled, the app keeps its saved progress).
gates.FEATURE_MWB_TEMPLATES: Wave B (owner day-1 list), true: programs backend (MWB-3 + #733) deployed; mobile Programs m#355-#358 merged and EXPO_PUBLIC_FF_MWB_PROGRAMS on in the production and clinic profiles for the 10-07 build. Apply with FEATURE_MWB_AUTOSAVE_UNDO and FEATURE_NAMED_REGIMES. Unset = off (only 'true'); emergency kill: unset (program library routes return 404; saved programs are kept).
gates.FEATURE_MWB_AUTOSAVE_UNDO: Wave B (owner day-1 list), true: same gate as FEATURE_MWB_TEMPLATES. Precondition: MWB_AUTOSAVE_LOCK_TOKEN_SECRET is github-secret in this file and the GitHub secret exists (64+ hex characters), because the autosave service throws without it. Mobile EXPO_PUBLIC_FF_MWB_AUTOSAVE flips with it. Unset = off (only 'true'); emergency kill: unset (autosave and undo routes return 404; ship the same kill to mobile EXPO_PUBLIC_FF_MWB_AUTOSAVE).
gates.FEATURE_NAMED_REGIMES: Wave B (owner day-1 list), true: same gate as FEATURE_MWB_TEMPLATES. Also turns on the partial-refund coach decision rows (Keep drops / Unassign drops); a pending decision changes nothing until the coach picks one. Unset = off (only 'true'); emergency kill: unset (regime and decision routes return 404, no new decision rows).
gates.FEATURE_DUNNING_V2: Wave B (owner day-1 list; folded in from #633): after backend #628 and mobile #322 are approved and the owner enables the Stripe customer portal in live mode. Roll back with 'unset'.
gates.FEATURE_COACH_CODE_TOOLS: Annex lane A2 (coach code tools): after the backend PR and the mobile Codes screen pass both audit lenses and a device pass. Roll back with 'unset'.
gates.FEATURE_COACH_BROADCASTS: A4 coach broadcasts, rich cards, saved replies and client tags (annex lane A4). Stays unset (off) until the backend PR and the mobile composer pass audit and a device pass; then the operator flips it to true. Unsetting it is the kill: routes answer 503 broadcasts.disabled and the dispatcher parks in-flight deliveries without re-sending delivered ones.
gates.GOOGLE_CLIENT_IDS: Wave B: launch-required Google sign-in audiences. The GitHub secret GOOGLE_CLIENT_IDS exists; flip to github-secret to copy it to Fly. Must be a comma list of non-empty client ids.
gates.MWB_AUTOSAVE_LOCK_TOKEN_SECRET: Precondition of FEATURE_MWB_AUTOSAVE_UNDO=true, github-secret in the same PR as the autosave flag. Merge only after the owner confirms the GitHub Actions secret MWB_AUTOSAVE_LOCK_TOKEN_SECRET exists on this repository (64+ hex characters, for example 'openssl rand -hex 32'); the plan fails closed while it is missing or too short.
